cv.name: Marcus Kingsley
cv.headline: VP of Product – B2B Fintech & Payments Platforms
cv.summary: Product leader with 17 years in payments and B2B software, the last seven leading product organizations. Has grown product teams from 6 to 40, launched new business lines and works closely with engineering, sales and the CEO on strategy.

experience.title: VP of Product
bullets: Lead a product organization of 38 (product managers, designers, analysts) across four product lines
Set the multi-year product strategy and roadmap with the executive team and board
Launched an embedded payments offering that reached $45M ARR within three years
Introduced quarterly product reviews and a shared metrics framework with engineering

experience.title: Director of Product Management
bullets: Managed the merchant onboarding and risk products; cut onboarding time from 9 days to 2
Built the first product operations function

experience.title: Senior Product Manager
bullets: Owned invoicing and accounts receivable modules for mid-market customers

experience.title: Business Systems Analyst
bullets: Wrote requirements for card processing system changes

education.school: Georgia State University, J. Mack Robinson College of Business

skills: Payments, card processing, risk and KYC
extra_sections: Mentor, Atlanta Tech Village product mentorship program
